title: Schauder bootstrap for C^{1,beta} solutions of the prescribed-mean-curvature graph system (Step 5)
statement:
Let n >= 1, q in N, 0 < alpha < 1, alpha <= beta <= 1, r > 0, O open in R^(n+l), F : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l) locally C^{q,alpha} on O, and u : R^n -> R^l C^1 on the open ball of radius r about 0 with (x, u(x)) in O there, Du(0) = 0, Du beta-Hoelder on that ball, and u a weak solution there of integral DJ(Du)[Dphi] dx = - integral J(Du) <(0, phi), F(x, u(x))> dx for all C^1 compactly supported phi with tsupport phi in the ball, where J(P) = sqrt(det(I_n + (

)_{a,b})). Then there is r' in (0, r] such that u is C^{q+2,alpha} on the open ball of radius r' in the sense of IsHolderCkα (q + 2) alpha: C^{q+2}, all derivatives of order <= q+2 bounded, and the (q+2)-th derivative alpha-Hoelder.
